about: S4b-BL-130: the sync/1 file and the Drive merge rule, run by Kotlin SyncVectorsTest and the website's sync-vectors.spec.ts. Digest: kind/key=by@updatedAt, ~ for a tombstone. Times are epoch milliseconds; the vectors' now is 2026-09-21T14:13:20Z.

an edit after an older one takes the clock

the same millisecond moves on by one
past a row stamped ahead within the day

order.name: nothing here: the incoming row is taken
a tie is broken by the device id: the greater wins

same time and device: a live row does not beat a tombstone

rows in any order, tombstones included

nested 64 deep is read (unknown keys are ignored)

houses.label: after A, clock an hour behind
